title: Exercise recorded-operation receipt identity and begin-shape refusals with valid producer fixtures
outcome: Exercise recorded-operation receipt identity and begin-shape refusals with valid producer fixtures
acceptance: Producer-derived begin-result fixtures change only receipt grant, session or task identity to another valid value; each whole inspection refuses without echoing keys or payloads.
A producer-derived checkpoint result with a different valid receipt grant refuses, and begin intents carrying next_intent or missing delivery_tokens reach the corresponding shape refusal.
The focused recorded-operation inspection tests pass with the guards present and detect removal of each receipt-identity or begin-shape guard.
